title: Durable good quality
text: Durable good quality. I got this for someone who is never warm at night one of those people who turn the thermostat up so high your sweating next to them and they are there still not warm enough.  This is a great gift for those type of people.  Easy to operate and use, looks good and is from a well known and trusted name brand.

product_metadata.title: Sunbeam Quilted Fleece Electric Blanket, King, Garnet
description: Get the warmth you need during the night while resting comfortably. This extra-soft, quilted fleece blanket gently wraps you in warmth with thermo fine technology to auto-adjust for consistent heat control and 10-heat settings. Machine-Washable and dryer-safe. Auto-Off feature for peace of mind.
